_provenance.purpose: Grounded alias table so a Science extinction pass (energy-extinction.js pattern) does not falsely retire activations. activeTriggers is built from pulse condition-codes (e.g. replication_failure) + active diagnosis ids (e.g. REPLICATION_CRISIS). In Science the CONDITION-CODES never textually equal an activation.diagnosticTrigger (which are free-text phrases such as “Replication failure rate spike”); this table bridges them.
_provenance.derivationChain: condition-code --(science-pulse-engine.js addFamily switch, L138-157)--> evidence family --(EVIDENCE_CONTRACTS requiredFamilies, OR-semantics, L167-170)--> diagnosis id --(science.json issues[]._authored circuit; adapter uses is._authored||is.circuits)--> circuit nodeIds --(these nodeIds are activations)--> FREE-TEXT diagnosticTriggers.
_provenance.foldRule: A diagnosis is folded into a condition-code only when the condition emits an evidence family that appears in that diagnosis requiredFamilies (matching the actual code gate = requiredFamilies with OR-semantics, NOT primaryIndicators). Link labels record whether the condition is that diagnosis’ primaryIndicator, secondaryConfirmation, or folds by family only. A named indicator whose emitted families do NOT satisfy the diagnosis requiredFamily is listed under secondaryDiagnoses and NOT folded (bias against over-marking); in Science no such case occurs (every named indicator also emits a satisfying family).
_provenance.discipline: No link invented. Conditions with no defensible chain are under unmapped. Trigger strings copied verbatim from science.json; extinction matching is case-insensitive (energy-extinction.js pattern).
_provenance.heterogeneityVsEnergyAndFinance: (1) STRUCTURE RESEMBLES ENERGY, NOT FINANCE: Science activation.diagnosticTriggers are FREE-TEXT phrases (“P-hacking signal”, “Citation manipulation”), so the diagnosis-id never self-matches and this bridge is strictly required end-to-end — exactly the Energy situation. Finance was the outlier (its triggers ARE diagnosis ids). (2) Science emits TWO catch-all-only families with no consumer: structural_event (from science_high_stress / structural_stress) and macro_event (from macro_shock); neither appears in any contract requiredFamilies, so both are dead-ends (see unmapped) — mirrors Finance macro_shock and Energy stress-token handling. (3) PARADIGM_CONFLICT is the sole diagnosis with catchAllBlocked:false (it may be validated by the stress catch-all without evidence); all five others are catchAllBlocked:true. (4) ORPHAN COUNT: Energy 1, Finance 3, Science 5 (HYPO, OFC, IPS, NTS, WERN) — the highest of the three; these activations carry diagnosticTriggers but sit in no _authored circuit and are reached by no condition-code chain. (5) OFC is a special orphan: it is the DATA_FRAUD *canonical* circuit node (circuits[0]) but was dropped from that issue’s _authored circuit, so under _authored-based wiring it is unreachable despite being a named canonical node.
